[LCSP.6.6] **Pool-exhaustion semantics.** When a pool fills under
`constspace`:

- `assert` returns `DS_ERR_OOM` (or the existing pool-full code)
  to the caller. The caller chooses what to do (retry, drop, log).
- A pump-time pool exhaustion drops the affected firing and emits
  a warning through the log callback, naming the pool that filled.
  The pump returns normally; the engine does not abort.
